Looking at this Duskull SH2 shiny card from the Stormfront set, I'll perform a systematic inspection.

## Initial Assessment
This is a shiny/secret rare Duskull with a gold border and holofoil pattern across the entire card face. The front shows intense rainbow holofoil reflections which are normal for this card type. The back shows the standard Pokemon card back.

## Catastrophic Scan (Both Sides First)
**Front:** Examining for creases - checking diagonals from each corner, horizontal mid-card lines. The holofoil creates many light streaks but these follow the rainbow pattern and don't show fractured texture. No line discontinuities crossing the print that would indicate a crease. No paper loss, tears, or water damage visible.

**Back:** Checking for creases carefully. The emboss filter (image 6) shows the card surface texture. I see some subtle waviness in the card stock but no sharp line discontinuities that would indicate a crease crossing the card. The energy swirls are soft-edged and curved - part of the design. No straight fractured white lines visible. No tears, paper loss, or water damage.

## Surface Inspection

**Front Surface (Step 3):**
- The holofoil shows intense rainbow reflections - this is normal for this card type
- Looking at the high-pass image (image 7), I can see the holofoil texture pattern
- No scratches cutting across the holofoil pattern
- No dents, pits, or print defects visible
- The gold border appears clean and intact
- Surface appears clean overall

**Back Surface (Step 6):**
- The back appears clean with good print quality
- Looking at the emboss (image 6) and high-pass (image 8) filters
- No visible scratches, dents, or surface damage
- No print defects or staining visible
- The surface texture appears uniform

## Corner/Edge Review (Already Measured - Not Reporting)
The pre-measured data indicates:
- Front corners and edges: all clean
- Back corners: showing wear (minor to severe per measurements)
- Back edges: clean

These are handled by the scoring engine, so I will not duplicate them.

## Crease Hunt Verification
Tracing diagonals on both sides and horizontal mid-card lines:
- Front: No crease lines detected - the light patterns are holofoil reflections with soft edges
- Back: No crease lines detected - the white swirls are part of the design (soft-edged, curved)

## Final Check
Re-reading against detection bias: No structural defects found (creases, tears, dents). The corner/edge wear is already captured by the measurement system. Surface appears clean on both sides.

Looking at this Duskull SH2 shiny holo card from the Platinum: Stormfront set.

## Initial Assessment
This is a reverse holo/shiny card with a gold border and prominent holofoil pattern across the entire card face. The front shows intense rainbow holofoil reflections which are normal for this card type. The back appears to be a standard Pokemon card back.

## Catastrophic Scan (Both Sides First)
**FRONT:** Checking for creases, tears, paper loss, water damage, writing. The holofoil creates strong rainbow reflections but I see no line discontinuities crossing the print that would indicate a crease. No hard-edged white patches interrupting artwork. No tears or water damage visible.

**BACK:** Examining carefully for structural damage. The back looks clean overall. Checking diagonals from each corner, horizontal mid-card lines. The energy swirls are soft-edged and curved - part of the design. I don't see any straight fractured lines crossing the Pokeball or spanning the card width. No creases, tears, or paper loss detected.

## Corner/Edge Analysis (Per Instructions - Already Measured)
The corner/edge model has already assessed these. I note the back corners show wear (particularly bottom corners marked as severe), but per instructions I will NOT report these as they go directly to scoring engine.

## Surface Inspection

**FRONT Surface:**
- The holofoil pattern shows intense rainbow shimmer - this is normal for this card type
- Examining the emboss/high-pass filtered images (5 & 7): The texture visible is consistent with holofoil pattern, not scratches
- No print lines, pits, dents, or scratches visible that cut across the holofoil pattern
- The gold border appears intact without chips or wear
- No stains or discoloration

**BACK Surface:**
- Examining images 4, 6, and 8 for surface defects
- The surface appears clean without scratches, dents, or print defects
- No pits or stains visible
- The blue coloring is consistent throughout

## Crease Hunt (Mandatory)
**FRONT:** Tracing diagonals from each corner, horizontal mid-card - no line discontinuities found. The filtered images don't show any ridge lines indicating creases.

**BACK:** Same systematic check - no crease lines visible. The filtered images (6 & 8) show normal card texture without any sharp discontinuities that would indicate a crease.

## Final Review
- No structural defects (creases, tears, dents, stains, pits) found on either surface
- Corner/edge wear is handled by the automated system
- The holofoil reflections are normal card features, not damage
